summary_en: Toray authorized acquisition of up to 74.0 million shares (5.1% of outstanding shares) for up to 7.0 billion yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 11, 2026 through June 30, 2027, funded by proceeds from sales of affiliated company and strategically held securities.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, Toray's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of up to 74.0 million shares (5.1% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 7.0 billion yen. The shares will be purchased through open market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 11, 2026 through June 30, 2027.

The company plans to fund the acquisition using proceeds from the sale of affiliated company shares and strategically held securities. This buyback is consistent with Toray's mid-term management initiative "IGNITION 2028," which emphasizes maintaining stable and continuous dividends while pursuing progressive dividend increases through earnings growth. The company stated that the acquisition supports dual objectives of strengthening financial condition and optimizing capital structure while implementing buybacks flexibly.
